code_inspection.determinism: PackLibrary sorts archive hashes; sourceResearch groups and counts use TreeMap; diverse ranks score descending then full citation ID
code_inspection.deduplication: PackLibrary combines same document identity and displayed metadata, retaining all collection provenance; diverse suppresses identical qualified IDs and rejects text, URL or provenance conflicts
code_inspection.deduplication_limit: diverse conflict check does not compare title, date or attribution fields; synthetic identity-conflict control varies text, URL and provenance together
code_inspection.selection: Per-collection four-hit diversity before global four-hit diversity; at most two passages per URL; no guarantee every collection contributes a quotation
code_inspection.cancellation: Workspace passes cancellation into in-memory retrieval, postings and collection loops; retry observed in supplied instrumentation
code_inspection.cancellation_limit: DiskProvider retrieval receives no stop supplier; polling occurs after provider returns; sorting and diverse loops do not poll
code_inspection.scope: Changed source-brief ranking and availability reporting; no generation or synthesis demonstrated
code_inspection.controls: Deletion uses isolated library; ID collision and duplicate provenance checks use constructed Passage objects rather than colliding archive imports; selection persistence compared across force-stop restart
code_inspection.conflict_limit: New constructed conflicting same-session requirements preserved without verdict; no automatic conflict detection, real-source temporal adjudication or contradiction resolution
